cond_0001.intro:

cond_0001.responsibilities: Key Responsibilities: Act as organization and suppliers' single-point-of-contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality. Review and approve/reject/amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components. Coordinate [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers. Perform source inspection and product assessments at suppliers.

cond_0150.intro:
[Company name masked]'s Quality Assurance Teams are responsible for all or part of an organization's Quality Management System, including conformance and continuous improvement initiatives. They work on systemic evaluation of products, services, facilities, manufacturing, or business processes, to ensure that standards of quality are being met. Develop and implement quality plans, programs and procedures using quality control statistics, lean manufacturing concepts, and six-sigma tools and analyses. They review, analyze and report on quality discrepancies, investigate problems and execute quality audits, and develop disposition and corrective actions for recurring discrepancies. The team works closely with manufacturing, engineering, customers, or suppliers and subcontractors to ensure requirements are met.
Under limited supervision, monitor, evaluate, select, and apply standard quality engineering principles and techniques to assigned business problems. Ensures results meet established needs and goals of [Company name masked]'s [Location masked] Sensor Division.
cond_0150.responsibilities: Act as the organization and suppliers' single point of contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality, staying in regular contact with both sides to keep things moving. Lead supplier-related APQP activities, connecting with suppliers early to ensure incoming quality is proactively planned and ensured before PPAP and production release. Continually improve supplier performance through coaching, teaching, training, consequence enforcement, supplier awards and motivation, supplier restriction and disqualification, etc. Measure and communicate supplier performance directly to those suppliers and to the organization. Evaluate, qualify, and approve new and competitive suppliers in ongoing collaboration with the commodity teams. Review and approve, reject, or amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components. Monitor quality data within the operating systems to ensure data accuracy and develop reporting systems to accurately document and record supplier trends and performance. Periodically monitor quality specifications to ensure supplier compliance. Work closely with engineering to clarify and change specs regarding incoming goods when necessary. Clearly communicate and enforce [Company name masked]'s requirements and expectations to suppliers. Solicit, drive, monitor, review, approve, and validate containment, corrective, and preventive actions by suppliers. Facilitate supplier quality roadmaps leading to improved supplier performance. Conduct process and system audits of suppliers and maintain working knowledge of ISO and TS quality system requirements. Chair QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with key suppliers, leading the discussion and handling questions directly. Coordinate [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers. Perform source inspection and product assessments at suppliers.
cond_0150.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or other engineering discipline plus 5+ years' experience in a manufacturing environment
5+ Years in a supplier development role
5+ Years conducting quality audits
Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt certification
Practical application of 8D, 5-why, and Ishikawa
Ability and willingness to travel up to 60–75% of the time
Strong people skills with comfort communicating directly with suppliers and internal teams

Working knowledge of ISO 9001; AS9100 preferred
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred over other disciplines

[Company name masked]'s Quality Assurance Teams are responsible for all or part of an organization's Quality Management System, including conformance and continuous improvement initiatives. They work on systemic evaluation of products, services, facilities, manufacturing, or business processes, to ensure that standards of quality are being met. Develop and implement quality plans, programs and procedures using quality control statistics, lean manufacturing concepts, and six-sigma tools and analyses. They review, analyze and report on quality discrepancies, investigate problems and execute quality audits, and develop disposition and corrective actions for recurring discrepancies. The team works closely with manufacturing, engineering, customers, or suppliers and subcontractors to ensure requirements are met.
Under limited supervision, monitor, evaluate, select, and apply standard quality engineering principles and techniques to assigned business problems. Ensures results meet established needs and goals of [Company name masked]'s [Location masked] Sensor Division.
cond_0397.responsibilities: Key Responsibilities: Act as organization and suppliers' single-point-of-contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality. Lead supplier related APQP activities to ensure incoming quality is proactively planned, prepared, and ensured in advance before PPAP and production release. Continually improve supplier performance through coaching, teaching, training, consequence enforcement, supplier awards and motivation, supplier restriction and disqualification, etc. Measure and communicate supplier performance to those suppliers and the organization. Evaluate, qualify, approve appropriate new, competitive suppliers (including search for new suppliers), in collaboration with the commodity teams. Review and approve/reject/amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components. Monitor quality data within the operating systems to ensure data accuracy and develop reporting systems to accurately document and record supplier trends and performance. Periodically monitor quality specifications to ensure supplier compliance. Work with engineering to clarify and change specs regarding incoming goods when necessary. Clearly communicate (and enforce) [Company name masked]'s requirements and expectations to suppliers. Solicit, drive, monitor, review, approve and validate containment/corrective/preventive actions by suppliers. Facilitate supplier quality roadmaps leading to improved supplier performance. Conduct process and system audits of suppliers and maintain working knowledge of ISO and TS quality system requirements. Chair QBRs (Quarterly Business Review) with key suppliers. Coordinate [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers. Perform source inspection and product assessments at suppliers.
cond_0397.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering or other engineering discipline
5+ Years' experience in a manufacturing environment
5+ Years in a supplier development role
5+ Years conducting quality audits
Practical application of 8D, 5-why and Ishikawa
Ability and willingness to travel up to 60% of the time
Excellent people skills
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of ISO 9001, preferably AS9100
Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt certification
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (preferred discipline)
cond_0397.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0397.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

cond_0448.intro:
[Company name masked]'s Quality Assurance Teams are responsible for all or part of an organization's Quality Management System, including conformance and continuous improvement initiatives. They work on systemic evaluation of products, services, facilities, manufacturing, or business processes, to ensure that standards of quality are being met. They develop and implement quality plans, programs and procedures using quality control statistics, lean manufacturing concepts, and six-sigma tools and analyses. They review, analyze and report on quality discrepancies, investigate problems and execute quality audits, and develop disposition and corrective actions for recurring discrepancies. The team interfaces with manufacturing, engineering, customers, or suppliers and subcontractors to ensure requirements are met.
Under limited supervision, monitor, evaluate, select, and apply standard quality engineering principles and techniques to assigned business problems. Ensures results meet established needs and goals of [Company name masked]'s [Location masked] Sensor Division.
cond_0448.responsibilities:
Serve as the single-point-of-contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality.
Lead supplier-related APQP activities to ensure incoming quality is proactively planned, prepared, and ensured before PPAP and production release.
Improve supplier performance through coaching, training, consequence enforcement, supplier awards, supplier restriction and disqualification, etc.
Measure and document supplier performance and share results with those suppliers and the organization.
Evaluate, qualify, and approve new and competitive suppliers (including sourcing new suppliers), in coordination with the commodity teams.
Review and approve, reject, or amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components.
Monitor quality data within operating systems to ensure data accuracy and develop reporting systems to accurately document and record supplier trends and performance.
Periodically monitor quality specifications to ensure supplier compliance.
Coordinate with engineering to clarify and update specs regarding incoming goods when necessary.
Communicate and enforce [Company name masked]'s requirements and expectations to suppliers.
Solicit, monitor, review, approve, and validate containment, corrective, and preventive actions by suppliers.
Support supplier quality roadmaps leading to improved supplier performance.
Conduct process and system audits of suppliers and maintain working knowledge of ISO and TS quality system requirements.
Chair QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews) with key suppliers.
Coordinate [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers.
Perform source inspection and product assessments at supplier sites.
cond_0448.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering or other engineering discipline plus 5+ years' experience in a manufacturing environment
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 preferred AS9100
5+ Years in a supplier development role
Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt certification
5+ Years conducting quality audits
Practical application of 8D, 5-why and Ishikawa
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Ability and willingness to travel up to 60% of the time

cond_0467.responsibilities:
Act as the organization and suppliers' single-point-of-contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality.
Lead supplier related APQP activities to ensure incoming quality is proactively planned, prepared, and ensured in advance before PPAP and production release.
Drive supplier performance improvement through coaching, teaching, training, consequence enforcement, supplier awards and motivation, supplier restriction and disqualification, etc.
Measure and communicate supplier performance to those suppliers and the organization.
Evaluate, qualify, and approve appropriate new, competitive suppliers (including search for new suppliers), in collaboration with the commodity teams.
Review and approve/reject/amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components.
Monitor quality data within the operating systems to ensure data accuracy and develop reporting systems to accurately document and record supplier trends and performance.
Periodically monitor quality specifications to ensure supplier compliance.
Work with engineering to clarify and change specs regarding incoming goods when necessary.
Clearly communicate and enforce [Company name masked]'s requirements and expectations to suppliers.
Solicit, drive, monitor, review, approve and validate containment/corrective/preventive actions by suppliers.
Lead supplier quality roadmaps to improved supplier performance.
Conduct process and system audits of suppliers and maintain working knowledge of ISO and TS quality system requirements.
Chair QBRs (Quarterly Business Review) with key suppliers.
Direct [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers.
Perform source inspection and product assessments at suppliers.

[Company name masked]'s Quality Assurance Teams are responsible for all or part of an organization's Quality Management System, including conformance and continuous improvement initiatives. They work on systemic evaluation of products, services, facilities, manufacturing, or business processes, to ensure that standards of quality are being met. Develop and implement quality plans, programs and procedures using quality control statistics, lean manufacturing concepts, and six-sigma tools and analyses. They review, analyze and report on quality discrepancies, investigate problems and execute quality audits, and develop disposition and corrective actions for recurring discrepancies. The team works closely with manufacturing, engineering, customers, or suppliers and subcontractors to ensure requirements are met.
Under limited supervision, own the monitoring, evaluation, selection, and application of standard quality engineering principles and techniques to assigned business problems. Deliver results that meet the established needs and goals of [Company name masked]'s [Location masked] Sensor Division.
cond_0476.responsibilities: Act as the organization and suppliers' single-point-of-contact for topics and issues related to supplier quality. Lead supplier-related APQP activities to ensure incoming quality is proactively planned, prepared, and ensured in advance before PPAP and production release. Drive continuous improvement in supplier performance through coaching, teaching, training, consequence enforcement, supplier awards and motivation, supplier restriction and disqualification, etc. Measure and communicate supplier performance to those suppliers and the organization. Evaluate, qualify, and approve new and competitive suppliers (including directing the search for new suppliers), in collaboration with the commodity teams. Review and approve/reject/amend supplier Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions for new product releases and qualifying changes to existing components. Monitor quality data within the operating systems to ensure data accuracy and build reporting systems to accurately document and record supplier trends and performance. Periodically monitor quality specifications to ensure supplier compliance. Work with engineering to clarify and change specs regarding incoming goods when necessary. Clearly communicate and enforce [Company name masked]'s requirements and expectations to suppliers. Solicit, drive, monitor, review, approve, and validate containment/corrective/preventive actions by suppliers. Lead supplier quality roadmaps to achieve improved supplier performance. Execute process and system audits of suppliers and maintain working knowledge of ISO and TS quality system requirements. Chair QBRs (Quarterly Business Review) with key suppliers. Direct [Company name masked] Supplier Days with key suppliers. Perform source inspection and product assessments at suppliers.
cond_0476.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or other engineering discipline plus 5+ years' experience in a manufacturing environment
5+ Years in a supplier development role
5+ Years conducting quality audits
Practical application of 8D, 5-why, and Ishikawa
Ability and willingness to travel up to 60–75% of the time
Excellent people skills
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
Working knowledge of ISO 9001; AS9100 preferred
Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt certification
